'''Francesc Ramirez''' (born 7 September 1976) is an [[Andorra]]n [[Association football|footballer]]. He has played for the [[Andorra national football team|Andorra national team]] and [[FC Santa Coloma|Santa Coloma]].

==Honours==
;CE Principat
*[[Primera Divisió]]: [[1997–98 Primera Divisió|1997–98]]<ref name="NFT" >{{cite web|url=http://www.national-football-teams.com/player/158/Francesc_Ramirez.html |title=Francesc Ramirez |work=National Football Teams |accessdate=28 September 2014 }}</ref>
*[[Copa Constitució]]: [[Copa Constitució#Champions|1998]]<ref name="NFT" />

;UE Sant Julià
*[[Primera Divisió]]: [[2004–05 Primera Divisió|2004–05]]<ref name="NFT" />

;FC Rànger's
*[[Primera Divisió]]: [[2005–06 Primera Divisió|2005–06]], [[2006–07 Primera Divisió|2006–07]]<ref name="NFT" />

;FC Santa Coloma
*[[Primera Divisió]]: [[2010–11 Primera Divisió|2010–11]], [[2013–14 Primera Divisió|2013–14]]<ref name="NFT" />
*[[Copa Constitució]]: [[2012 Copa Constitució|2012]]<ref name="NFT" />
